verdict.rationale: New Relic is SaaS-only, and nothing in the evidence shows a local, self-hosted or on-prem instance of the platform. Community reports note that its development mode was removed and describe an underserved on-premise need. The closest workaround is the perpetual free tier with 100 GB/month ingest, which gives a hosted account you can point dev instrumentation at and build test dashboards in. Missing for 10: a runnable local or self-hosted platform instance, a dedicated dev or sandbox mode, documentation for isolated dev environments, and hands-on corroboration of a dev workflow.
